name: Tana
tagline: The visible structured networked notes loop is buildable, but a credible replacement needs more than the first screen. Tana earns its keep through polish, sync, importers, so expect a weekend or multi-day build and a narrower personal scope.
verdictSummary: KINDA: Tana costs $10/mo ($120/yr). Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
